meta.name: gh-issues
meta.description: Fetch GitHub issues, spawn sub-agents to implement fixes and open PRs, then monitor and address PR review comments. Usage: /gh-issues [owner/repo] [--label bug] [--limit 5] [--milestone v1.0] [--assignee @me] [--fork user/repo] [--watch] [--interval 5] [--reviews-only] [--cron] [--dry-run] [--model glm-5] [--notify-channel -1002381931352]

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动抓取 GitHub issue，修复并提交 PR，跟踪审查意见
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从 GitHub issue 出发完成修复并提交 PR
copy.tagline_en: Fetch GitHub issues, implement fixes, open PRs, and monitor reviews
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to fix GitHub issues and submit PRs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的命令拉取 GitHub 仓库的 issue，启动子代理去修复代码并创建 Pull Request，还能持续检查 PR 的评审意见并自动处理。
howto.when: 当你说出以“/gh-issues”开头的命令时触发；如果使用了“--watch”选项，还会持续轮询新 issue 和 PR 评审。

say.note: 持续监听当前仓库的PR评审。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can fetch GitHub issues from a repository, spawn sub-agents to implement fixes and open pull requests, and monitor PR review comments to address them automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say a command starting with "/gh-issues"; if the "--watch" flag is used, it continues polling for new issues and PR reviews.

say_en.note: Fetches up to 5 issues with the bug label.
